Headline claim: No AI resolution rate published. Customer claims: Swiss Life 96% routing accuracy and 60% faster resolution; BER 85% CSAT.
Label(s) the vendor uses: routing accuracy, faster resolution, containment, FCR
Published definition (paraphrased): Glossary defines containment as issues resolved through self service without agent escalation, and calls it synonymous with deflection. Separate FCR article defines a strict first contact rate with eligibility exclusions. Lens dashboard shows an LLM verified resolution metric.
Contradiction or tension found: Treats containment and deflection as resolution in its glossary, while its own FCR article says an issue needing a repeat contact is not resolved.

Headline claim: 99.8% accuracy; from about $1.25 per resolution; no charge for unresolved or low CSAT conversations.
Label(s) the vendor uses: true resolution rate, accuracy, first contact resolution
Published definition (paraphrased): True resolution rate is the share of conversations where the customer's problem was actually solved. Warns that containment flatters vendors.
Contradiction or tension found: Bills only for resolved conversations, but does not say publicly who decides a conversation counts as resolved. A competitor (Fin) says the 99.8% covers blended AI and human work.

Headline claim: Up to 93% autonomous resolution; named results from 80% to 93%.

Contradiction or tension found: Headline 93% for Mastermind is described as live chat questions answered; Maven also reports Mastermind resolved 68% of support page inquiries. Papaya: 90% answered autonomously but 70% first contact resolution.
Date on page: Not shown (posts about 1 to 2 months old)

Headline claim: Resolve up to 80% of conversations; DoorDash 94%; Sunrun 50% of payment calls.
Label(s) the vendor uses: resolution rate, success rate, fully automated
Published definition (paraphrased): Its voice AI metrics post defines resolution rate as calls the AI handled entirely without a transfer to a human, which is the usual definition of containment.
Contradiction or tension found: DoorDash 94% is a success rate on Replicant's ROI blog and a resolution rate on a partner page. Sunrun 50% is fully automated on one page and resolved without a live agent on the homepage.
The same 60% reads resolve calls without agents on one page and automate incoming calls on the demo page.

Headline claim: Up to 70% resolution rates without human involvement.
Published definition (paraphrased): Resolution means handled without human involvement. No follow up or repeat contact condition stated.
Contradiction or tension found: Positions itself as resolution first while defining resolution the way others define containment.

Headline claim: 97% containment for inbound support (eHealth); 99.5% resolution without human handoff (reported).
Published definition (paraphrased): No public definition found. Resolution described as no human handoff.

Headline claim: No resolution rate published. Kin Insurance: +18.7% improvement in transfer rate.

Headline claim: AI Agent automation rate; claims up to 60% of common questions.

Source(s): docs.gorgias.com (How metrics are calculated: AI and automation) ; docs.gorgias.com/en-US/automate-statistics-81942
Date on page: Updated within last week per page

Label(s) the vendor uses: booking rate, handled automatically, transfer rate
